historical_state_policy: Historical state files are evidence only. Their continuation markers, runtime counts, test counts, deployment state, and exact-next-source fields must not be treated as current authority.

source_acquisition.reason: CONTINUATION_AUTHORITY.json remains CONFLICT_REQUIRES_RECONCILIATION and has no verified next source.

canonical_promotion.reason: Continuation reconciliation and separate promotion approval are required.

blocking_requirements: Before any live provider preflight, the exact provider candidate must have independent PROVIDER_CANDIDATE_SELECTION_APPROVED evidence from an explicit owner decision. Generic proceed/continue instructions are not provider-candidate approval.
A dedicated RamaVerse-owned MySQL/MySQL-compatible preview database service must be selected, provisioned and identified explicitly.
The Aiven free-tier dedicated-service attempt remains blocked by the provider quota; PREVIEW_INFRASTRUCTURE_STATUS.json records that evidence.
PREVIEW_DATABASE_COMPATIBILITY.json records static portability candidates but does not approve any provider before live schema/integration validation.
Canonical Reader rows must be loaded and verified independently from schema existence.
Exact deployed commit must pass preview HTTP and integration QA.
A successful deployed preview smoke run must be followed by explicit owner preview acceptance backed by PREVIEW_ACCEPTANCE_PASS evidence; preview acceptance does not authorize production.

Before the first live preview deployment, at least one previously green exact commit must be demonstrably eligible as a source rollback target through RamaVerse Preview Rollback Readiness; actual provider-specific rollback execution remains separately undefined until a provider is selected.

Before any live preview deployment execution, the exact commit/provider must have matching PREVIEW_DEPLOYMENT_AUTHORIZED evidence backed by successful exact-commit release checks, LIVE_INTEGRATION_PASS, PREVIEW_ROLLBACK_READY and explicit owner preview deployment approval. Authorization itself performs no deployment.

A provider-specific preview deploy executor must consume PREVIEW_DEPLOYMENT_HANDOFF_READY evidence for the exact authorized commit/provider. The handoff contains only sanitized runtime-contract metadata and secret names; it performs no provider, database, deployment or production mutation.

Before any provider-specific preview executor can run, the exact commit/provider must also have PREVIEW_DEPLOYMENT_EXECUTOR_ADMITTED evidence produced from the sanitized handoff and PREVIEW_DEPLOYMENT_EXECUTOR_REGISTRY.json. The registry defaults to DENY and an executor must be separately reviewed, enabled and mapped to a concrete workflow before admission can pass.

agent_rules: Fresh-check main, open PRs, open issues, and running workflows before every write task.
Stop when another agent is modifying the same area.
Do not import, develop, deploy, or repair legacy RamaVerse repositories or historical website exports.
Do not fabricate missing Sarga rows or infer corpus presence from schema existence.
Do not use PROJECT_STATE.json or RAMAVERSE_PROJECT_STATE.json as current continuation authority.
Do not publish staging or reconciliation records through public Reader, Search, Ask, or offline canonical surfaces.
Do not silently reuse a shared cross-project database service.
Do not treat static provider compatibility as live provider approval.

Do not interpret generic proceed, continue or next-task instructions as provider-candidate approval; explicit PROVIDER_CANDIDATE_SELECTION_APPROVED evidence is required before live provider preflight.
Do not reuse a provider-candidate selection artifact for a different provider candidate.
Do not treat PROVIDER_CANDIDATE_SELECTION_APPROVED as provider runtime approval, paid-plan approval, provisioning approval, deployment authorization or production authorization.
Do not treat preview acceptance, preview rollback readiness, preview deployment authorization, preview deployment handoff or preview executor admission as production authorization.
Do not treat PREVIEW_ROLLBACK_READY as proof that provider-specific rollback execution or database rollback is safe.

Do not execute a live preview deployment unless matching PREVIEW_DEPLOYMENT_AUTHORIZED, PREVIEW_DEPLOYMENT_HANDOFF_READY and PREVIEW_DEPLOYMENT_EXECUTOR_ADMITTED evidence exists for the exact commit/provider and the selected provider-specific deployment implementation has separately been reviewed and enabled.
Do not treat PREVIEW_DEPLOYMENT_AUTHORIZED as evidence that deployment has occurred; its execution_performed field must remain false.
Do not treat PREVIEW_DEPLOYMENT_HANDOFF_READY as evidence that provider configuration, secret injection, database mutation or deployment has occurred.
Do not treat PREVIEW_DEPLOYMENT_EXECUTOR_ADMITTED as evidence that deployment has occurred; executor admission itself performs no execution.
Do not bypass PREVIEW_DEPLOYMENT_EXECUTOR_REGISTRY.json default DENY or enable an executor from generic proceed/continue instructions.
Do not place credential values or connection strings containing credentials into the deployment handoff artifact; secret names only are allowed.
Do not create paid infrastructure without explicit owner approval of the paid plan and cloud/region.
